title: the verdict-deposit ledger closes a berth on librarian node addresses
intention: mark_deposited accepts a landing of librarian node addresses (positive ints, outline 4.3.1.5.1.1) as well as legacy non-blank string ids, and still refuses an empty landing or a non-id.
why: Measured 2026-11-14 on the 06db stack: codemother's drain landed four int addresses and mark_deposited refused them as 'landed no node ids' (it accepted only str), so the berth stood pending forever and test_deposit went red.
traces_to: Law 7 — a record of truth records what happened; a full landing refused as empty is a lie of omission.
how: A _a_node_id predicate (positive int, not bool; or non-blank str); a lone int is wrapped like a lone str. Red-first proof over scratch ledgers.

clauses.claim: mark_deposited with positive int addresses (a list, and a lone int) records them as given and pending() stops returning the berth
an empty list, 0, a negative int, True and a blank string are each refused with VerdictRefused and append nothing; a legacy string id still closes

decisions.text: D2: red-first proof, one tooth per clause.

measured.saw: test_deposit red on the 06db stack: VerdictRefused mark_deposited landed no node ids ([281474976710664, ...]); the new proof red on 06db (0/2), green with D1 (2/2)
measured.how: bin/cairn test --exec over test_deposit and the new proof, in wt-06db and wt-185b
